title: Pareto points in growing dimensions
summary: We consider $n$ independent random points uniformly distributed in the $d_n$-dimensional unit cube and study Pareto points, that is, points that do not coordinatewise dominate any other point. We identify the critical growth rate of $d_n$ at which a phase transition occurs: below this threshold, the number of non-Pareto points diverges in probability, whereas above it there are asymptotically no such points. At criticality, the number of non-Pareto points converges in distribution to a Poisson random variable. We further describe their asymptotic spatial distribution in terms of convergence…
